msg: Hola, buen día. Somos un grupo de 7 amigas de Bogotá. Tres ya tenemos el Open Water, dos quieren probar el minicurso y dos prefieren snorkel. ¿Cuánto saldría por persona saliendo desde Cartagena y hay descuento por grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Buen día! ¡Qué plan tan bacano, 7 amigas juntas en las Islas del Rosario! 🌊 Y sí, se puede combinar todo en el mismo tour: las certificadas bucean, las del minicurso hacen su entrenamiento y luego se pueden unir en la inmersión, y el snorkel va por su zona. Cada una disfruta lo suyo y se encuentran en la lancha.

Sobre el descuento: sí, para grupos de 5 personas o más hay un 10% adicional que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). Ojo: no es automático, hay que pedirlo al equipo **antes de pagar**, porque si pagan sin pedirlo se pierde.

Te dejo los precios por persona a continuación 👇

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

¿Quieres que te ayude a armar la reserva para las 7?

msg: Hello. My wife and I arrive on a cruise ship in Cartagena on March 3rd, docking at 7:00 am and we must be back on board by 5:00 pm. We would both like to snorkel. Is that doable? We are from Canada.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

What a great plan — snorkeling in the Rosario Islands is a beautiful experience, and the reefs there are full of life. 🐠

And yes, it fits your schedule. The snorkeling tour from Cartagena runs like this:

- Meeting point: Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. (5 minutes from the historic center)
- Speedboat to the Rosario Islands (about 1 hour)
- Two guided snorkeling sessions with a surface interval
- Lunch at the hotel facilities
- Return to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m., arriving around 4:15 p.m.

That leaves you a comfortable margin before the 5:00 p.m. boarding time. One thing to keep in mind: there's no hotel pick-up from Cartagena — you'd make your own way to the dock.

The price is 126 USD per person online (140 USD regular), and it includes the boat, lunch, snorkeling gear and the National Natural Park entrance fee. No certification needed, and the minimum age is 6.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: I see, thanks. Is there anything shorter we could do that gets us back by 3 pm? Or could we go from the islands somehow?
reply:
The snorkeling tour is the shortest activity we have, and its times are fixed — they can't be moved earlier or later. From Cartagena the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m., so it doesn't get you back by 3:00 p.m.

Going from the islands would work better time-wise: pick-up at your hotel between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (if the hotel has boat access), two snorkeling sessions, and back at your hotel around 12:00–1:00 p.m. But that only helps if you're actually staying on the Rosario Islands — coming in on a cruise ship, you'd be docked in Cartagena, so that route isn't really an option for you that day.

So realistically, with a 3:00 p.m. return, the Cartagena snorkeling tour doesn't fit. If you can stretch to the 5:00 p.m. boarding time, it does work with a comfortable margin.

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll give you the exact plan. 🌊

If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.

If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.

- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.

msg: Ok from Cartagena. We are from Milan, the 12th of May. Is lunch vegetarian possible? And what do we have to bring?
reply:
Perfect, from Cartagena it is! 🌊 And yes — vegetarian lunch is no problem at all.

**Lunch:** vegetarians, vegans and celiacs get rice with vegetables instead of rice with chicken. If either of you has a specific allergy (shellfish, gluten, nuts…), just let us know before the tour so the team can manage it. You're also welcome to bring your own food if you prefer.

**What to bring:** swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. That's it — the diving equipment is included in the mini-course. 🐠

A couple of practical notes:
- Meeting point is **Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m.**, 5 minutes from the historic center. There's no hotel pick-up from Cartagena, so you get to the dock on your own.
- Each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat.
- There's a medical form to fill in for the mini-course (it's in Spanish) — it comes with your booking confirmation, and the insurance form too.
- And remember: wait at least 12 hours after diving before flying.

May 12th sounds like a lovely plan — the Caribbean is warm and clear that time of year. 😊

msg: Hi, my flight lands in Cartagena on Saturday at 11:30 am and I leave on Sunday at 8 pm. I'm PADI Advanced, last dive 3 months ago. Could I fit in some diving? I'm from the UK.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Great that you're thinking about diving with us — the Rosario Islands are beautiful and you'd love it 🌊

Let me be straight with you on the timing, because it's the key point: after recreational diving you need to wait at least 18 hours before flying, counted from your last dive. With your flight out on Sunday at 8 pm, the last dive has to be on Saturday at the latest — a dive on Sunday doesn't work, even though the boat would be back before you leave.

And Saturday is tight: our trips from Cartagena leave at 8:00 am from Muelle de la Bodeguita, so a landing at 11:30 am doesn't fit a Saturday dive either.

So with those flights, unfortunately there's no window for diving this trip. If you could shift your flight to Monday morning (7:00 am or later), a Saturday dive would work perfectly — you're PADI Advanced and 3 months since your last dive is no problem at all.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like me to help you look at options in case your flights can be adjusted?

Diving Planet policies:
- Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.
- If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.
- For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
- Muelle de la Bodeguita, 5 minutes from the historic center, at 8:00 AM. Departing from Cartagena there is no hotel pick-up: each person gets to the dock on their own (ground transportation to the dock is not included).
- By booking you accept our terms and conditions, cancellation policy, and data treatment. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Date changes are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Changes to the number of people on a booking you already made are subject to availability and our terms and conditions. See: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Colombians (anyone with Colombian nationality, holding a Colombian cédula or passport, wherever they live; also dual nationals when one nationality is Colombian) and residents of Colombia (holders of a cédula de extranjería, a resident ID; living in Colombia without one is not enough) pay in Colombian pesos (COP). Saying they are Colombian or from a Colombian city ("I'm from Cali") already says it; what is not enough is only having been born there while living abroad: then ask whether they hold Colombian nationality or a cédula de extranjería. All other international clients pay in US dollars (USD). A group does not pay in parts: if the same booking mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group pays in US dollars (USD), residents and Colombians included. A Colombian together with someone who holds a cédula de extranjería, wherever they are from, is not a mixed group: both pay in pesos (COP). The price is the same: only the currency changes (there is no discount for being Colombian).
- If the group mixes Colombians or residents with international clients who hold no cédula de extranjería, the whole group booking is paid in US dollars (USD), at the same equivalent price. Someone with a cédula de extranjería does not count as a foreigner, wherever they are from. There is no different price for being Colombian.
- If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.
- These plans have different prices because they do not include transport from Cartagena or lunch.
- Pick-up is only on the Rosario Islands: Barú (including Playa Blanca, which is on Barú) is not part of the islands and we do not operate or pick up there; guests staying in Barú depart from Cartagena (Muelle de la Bodeguita).
- It depends on the activity: snorkeling from 6 years old; Bubble Makers from 8 to 10 years old (pool mini-course and very shallow water practice, max 2 meters); the dive mini-course and the Open Water course from 10 years old; the Advanced course and the Rescue course from 12. Minors must be accompanied by a demonstrable parent or responsible relative.
- The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
- If you are a certified diver, there are no additional medical restrictions; your liability waiver is the certified-diver one: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-buzo-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). For the refresher day this one is not used: use the course medical form.
- Bringing or drinking alcohol on the boat or during the activity is not allowed, and no alcohol or other substances may be consumed before diving. You must be in good physical condition.
- The booking system on our website. It automatically closes at 4:30 PM the day before: after that time you can no longer book for the next day, and you still book on the website for the next available day.
- To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
- From Cartagena: departure at 8:00 a.m. from Muelle de la Bodeguita and return at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.). From the islands: hotel pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties and 7:30 a.m. on day 2 of some courses). Daytime activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m. (see the activity schedule). Night diving: in the evening (pick-up around 5:30 p.m., back around 7:30 p.m.). Online booking system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before; after that, you book on the website for the next available day.
- We only close on December 25 and January 1. The rest of the year we operate every day, including public holidays, except for suspension due to adverse weather conditions.
- The tour includes water all day, coconut candy between dives, and lunch (rice with chicken or rice with vegetables). The menu is always the same, it does not change by day/supplier. Vegetarians, vegans, and celiacs receive rice with vegetables. Guests may bring their own food if needed (e.g. allergy or special diet). If the guest has a food allergy, they must inform us before the tour. In multi-day packages departing from Cartagena, lunch is included on the first day only; plans for guests already on the islands do not include lunch.
- Photos and videos are not offered proactively or included in the price. The instructor may take them voluntarily and delivers them by the next day at the latest. Any tip to the instructor for photos/videos is voluntary: each guest gives whatever they like, directly to them. This applies to every activity, including the mini-course (and the refresher, booked as a mini-course), PADI courses and certified-diver trips: not included, the instructor may take them voluntarily.
- The 3, 4, 5, 7 and 9 dive packages are exclusively for certified divers with a minimum Open Water level. They are not available for uncertified beginners.
- Two-day courses (Open Water, Referral Course, Advanced, Rescue and Mindful Diving) require accommodation on the islands: at least one night, the night of day 1 (there is no return to Cartagena on day 1). There is no option to commute from Cartagena on both days. Accommodation is not included and must be booked directly with the hotel. The same goes for multi-day dive packages (4, 5, 7 and 9 dives): you stay on the islands, and accommodation, which is not included, is booked directly with the hotel.
- Private services and closed groups are available, with no fixed price (it depends on the group and the date). A member of our team prepares the quote and coordinates an available instructor for the date.
- Through DIVE TO HEAL, more than 360 people with disabilities have been served. Accepted conditions include: hearing impairment (deaf), visual impairment (blind), reduced mobility (wheelchair), Down Syndrome, Cerebral Palsy, and Autism (depending on level and assessment). All instructors are trained in adaptive diving. Advance notice is recommended. The limitation is the presence of additional medical conditions that contraindicate diving.
- If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.
- We dive in the Rosario Islands, inside the Corales del Rosario y San Bernardo National Natural Park, about 45-60 minutes by boat from Cartagena.
- All daytime activities (dive trips, mini-course, snorkeling, courses and each day of the packages) end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., followed by lunch. Guests departing from Cartagena have lunch included on the islands and the boat returns to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.); guests staying on the islands return to their hotel around 12:00-1:00 p.m. for lunch (lunch not included). On overnight courses and packages, day 1's daytime activities also end around 12:00-1:00 p.m., and then you go to your hotel on the islands. Night diving (on plans that include it) is separate, in the evening (see each plan's schedule).
- There is always availability (confirmed by the business). We only close on December 25 and January 1, and a trip can be suspended due to adverse weather. The date and number of people are chosen in the booking link. To book for the next day, you need to do it before 4:30 p.m. (see booking system cutoff). Booking for the SAME day is no longer possible (trips leave in the morning and the website closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before): you book for the next available day.

- What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
- At our base on the island there are lockers where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive or snorkel.
- There is no minimum number of people: every activity runs even for a single person.
- Activities and courses are taught in Spanish and English. If a participant speaks neither language, they can come with someone who interprets for them, but instruction is still given in Spanish or English.
- Bookings are made on our website, through each activity's link (with the 10% online discount). Plans with no booking link (the 3- and 4-dive packages, the 9-dive package from the islands, the 1-dive trip from the islands, Bubble Makers, Divemaster and the private service) are booked by an advisor in this chat.

- The mini-course is a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving: it does not certify, does not count as part of any PADI course and requires nothing from PADI beforehand (no PADI account or PADI online course). - International clients pay 100% by card on the website; with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document.
- Colombians and residents of Colombia (including holders of a cédula de extranjería) pay in pesos and do not use the website booking link: a team advisor always closes the booking in this chat and sends them the link, QR code or Llave to pay 100% online or a 50% deposit, and the other 50% on the day of the activity, by card or cash. - If you leave the next day around noon: from the Rosario Islands it is very tight (pickup is between 9:30 and 9:45 and the activity ends around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), so it is best to confirm it with a team advisor; departing from Cartagena it does not fit (the boat returns at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.). - Customers paying in US dollars book and pay through the online link: the payment is recorded right away and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking; only if the online payment fails does the team send a link to pay by transfer.
- If the booking system or the online payment fails, our team sends you a link to pay by bank transfer, and the 10% online discount is kept (because the online payment failed). Outside that case there is no payment by transfer: the 10% discount is for booking and paying online.
- In groups combining diving and snorkeling, snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people everyone goes on the same boat; otherwise the group is split by activity.
- Besides our base (Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso, on Isla Grande), other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao. Accommodation is not included: it is booked directly with the hotel.
- To book an activity departing from the islands, the customer must already have their hotel and tell us which one: pickup is arranged there. If they don't have it yet, they first book the hotel and message us with its name; then we book. If they booked the activity first, the hotel could be cancelled, it could be full, they could forget to tell us or end up departing from Cartagena. If they stay in a house, an Airbnb or a hotel not on our list, they tell us the name and an advisor confirms the pickup before they book and pay: they do not book until then.
- Returning to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included. If the guest wants to stay longer on the islands and come back with us another day, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.).
- Departure and pickup times are fixed: they cannot be moved earlier or later. If you need an adjustment, a team advisor reviews it.
- Cancellations due to bad weather are unlikely because the Rosario Islands are in sheltered waters. If the Port Authority (Capitanía de Puerto) closes departures to the islands, we first try to reschedule the activity so you don't lose your booking. If rescheduling is not possible, you get a 100% refund. See the terms and conditions: https://divingplanet.org/terminos-y-condiciones/
- Scuba diving is not possible during pregnancy: no mini-course, no dive trips and no courses (DAN and obstetricians advise against it for the whole pregnancy). Surface snorkeling is possible, with her doctor's approval. Whoever comes with her can dive as usual.
- If you get seasick on the boat (the ride to the islands is about 1 hour by speedboat): have a light breakfast before leaving and consider seasickness tablets. If you take any medication, ask your doctor whether you can dive with it.
- We do issue invoices (also to companies). An advisor from our team coordinates the invoice details with the customer.
- There is no maximum age for diving: an older person can dive with the same medical form as everyone else.
- We carry oxygen and a first-aid kit on board, with trained staff, and there is an emergency protocol.
- Groups are small and follow PADI safety standards for each activity.
- The boat is a regular speedboat with no bathroom. On the islands we use the facilities of the hotel where lunch is served: that is where you change, use the bathroom and shower.
- Diving Planet has no parking of its own; there are public car parks in the old town area, and the easiest way to reach the pier is by taxi.
- There is no gift card, but you can book in someone else's name; the date and details are arranged with an advisor.
- Smoking is not allowed on the boat.
- Pets are not allowed on the boat: we go to a National Natural Park.
- Babies and young children who are not yet old enough for any activity (snorkeling starts at 6) can ride the boat with their parents at any age, and they ride free.
- You can bring your own camera on the dives or snorkeling, at your own risk. Diving Planet does not rent cameras.

Question: How long do I have to wait to fly after diving?
Other ways to ask: Can I fly the same day I dive? / What's the minimum time between diving and flying?
Answer: Wait at least 18 hours to take a flight after recreational diving. 12 hours minimum after the mini course (only for non-certified divers). The refresher is also 18 hours: it is for certified divers, even though it is booked as the mini course. The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. The mini course dive ends around 12:00 (noon): its 12 hours count from then. If the last dive is a daytime one, the refresher's included (activities end around 12:00-1:00 p.m.), you can fly from 7:00 a.m. the next day; after the mini-course, from midnight that same day. If the last dive is a night dive, the hours count from it. A flight the next day at 7:00 a.m. or later IS fine: they can dive the day before, and that day's return time to Cartagena changes nothing. For a certified diver, a flight on the SAME day as the dive NEVER works, whatever the time, even at night: with a flight on Sunday night, the last dive must be on Saturday at the latest; the boat being back before they leave does not fix it. If they say they leave that day without saying how, they are probably flying: tell them this. When answering, first say from what time they can fly and then compare it with their flight; do not start with yes or no.

msg: Wait, I fly on Sunday at 8 pm. So can I dive on Sunday morning and still fly that night?
reply:
No — a dive on Sunday morning doesn't work with a Sunday night flight. 🐠

After recreational diving you need to wait at least 18 hours before flying, and those hours count from your last dive. If you dive Sunday morning, the earliest you could fly would be Monday morning — so a Sunday 8 pm flight is out, whatever the time of day.

For a certified diver, a flight on the same day as the dive never works, even at night. The boat being back in Cartagena before you leave doesn't change it.

So with your flights, the last dive would have to be on Saturday at the latest — and Saturday is tight too, since the boat from Cartagena leaves at 8:00 am from Muelle de la Bodeguita and you land at 11:30 am.

If you can move your flight to Monday morning (7:00 am or later), a Saturday dive fits perfectly — you're PADI Advanced and 3 months since your last dive is no problem at all.

Would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Then I'll give you the exact plan. 🌊

msg: Hello, I have my Advanced and 40 logged dives, and I'd like to do the Rescue Diver course. Do I need EFR? How many days and how much? I'm from France and I'm already staying on Isla Grande at Cocoliso.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Great choice — the Rescue Diver course is one of the most rewarding steps a diver can take. It's more about awareness and prevention than pure physical effort, and most divers come out of it with a completely new mindset in the water. 🌊

On your questions:

**EFR:** The Rescue course requires recent EFR or first-aid training. Our Rescue plan is sold as **Rescue Course + EFR**, so the EFR is included in the program — you don't need to arrange it separately.

**Duration:** 2 days. Day 1 covers surface rescue practice, EFR exercises, rescue scenarios in the water and first-aid theory/practice. Day 2 continues the rescue and EFR practical training, finishing with your PADI Rescue Diver certification.

**Logistics:** Since it's a two-day course, you need to stay on the islands at least the night of day 1 (there's no return to Cartagena that day). You're already at Cocoliso on Isla Grande, which is one of our base hotels, so pickup there is confirmed and included. The course itself is priced and set up as departing from Cartagena (it includes the boat from Cartagena), so how to run it from the islands in your case is something a team advisor confirms — would you like me to connect you with one?

**Requirements:** Advanced Open Water certification (you have it), minimum age 12, and the medical form is required for courses — it's in Spanish: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol

I'm leaving the price per person below. And a small note: after diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying. ✈️

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Rescue Course + EFR: 796 USD · 884 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like me to help you move forward with the booking?

msg: Buenas. Soy español, tengo el título de Advanced y estaré unos días en las Islas del Rosario el mes que viene. Aún no tengo hotel, pero querría dejar ya reservadas 2 inmersiones. ¿Puedo reservar ahora y daros el hotel más adelante?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡bienvenido! Qué bueno que quieras bucear con nosotros en las Islas del Rosario 🌊

Para reservar una salida desde las islas necesitamos que ya tengas hotel y nos digas cuál, porque la recogida se coordina allí. Si reservas la actividad antes de tenerlo, puede pasar que luego te cancelen el hotel, que no quede sitio o que acabes saliendo desde Cartagena. Así que el orden es: primero reservas tu hotel, nos escribes con el nombre, y ahí reservamos el buceo.

Si te alojas en una casa, un Airbnb o un hotel fuera de nuestra lista, igual nos dices el nombre y un asesor confirma la recogida antes de reservar y pagar.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo (en los de varios días, el del primer día)
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 287 USD · 319 USD
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 316 USD · 351 USD
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 124 USD · 138 USD
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 188 USD · 209 USD
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 204 USD · 227 USD

Siempre hay disponibilidad: operamos todos los días, festivos incluidos, salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero; si el mar no está apto, la salida se reprograma.

Entonces, ¿ya estarás en las *Islas del Rosario* (salida desde las islas)? 🌴

msg: Sí, saldría desde las islas. Pero el hotel lo decidiré más adelante y me preocupa quedarme sin plaza para bucear. ¿De verdad no se puede dejar reservado ya y os digo el hotel en cuanto lo tenga? Si hace falta, pago ahora.
reply:
Entiendo tu preocupación, pero no: para reservar saliendo desde las islas necesitamos que ya tengas hotel y nos digas cuál, porque la recogida se coordina allí. Si reservaras antes, podría cancelarte el hotel, no quedar sitio, o acabar saliendo desde Cartagena. Así que el orden es: primero reservas tu hotel, nos escribes con el nombre, y ahí reservamos. Si es una casa, un Airbnb o un hotel fuera de nuestra lista, nos dices el nombre y un asesor confirma la recogida antes de reservar y pagar.

Y tranqui con las plazas: siempre hay disponibilidad, operamos todos los días salvo el 25 de diciembre y el 1 de enero. La fecha y las personas se eligen en el enlace de reserva, y para el día siguiente hay que reservar antes de las 4:30 p.m. (el mismo día ya no se puede).

Para reservar desde las islas necesito saber en qué hotel te alojas: la recogida se coordina allí y, si el hotel cambia o se cancela, cambia también tu plan. Si aún no lo tienes, resérvalo primero y escríbeme con el nombre; entonces seguimos con la reserva. 🌊

msg: Solo yo. ¿A qué hora me recogerían en el Cocoliso y tengo que llevar algo? Gracias.
reply:
En Cocoliso la recogida está confirmada e incluida: te recogen entre las 9:30 y las 9:45, te llevan a nuestra base, haces las 2 inmersiones con su intervalo de superficie y vuelves al hotel hacia las 12:00-13:00. 🕤

Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo va incluido, así que no tienes que llevar nada de eso. Eso sí, lleva tu carnet de buceo (o mándanos una foto antes) y completa el formato del seguro que te llega en el correo de confirmación. Y ojo: después de bucear hay que esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo.

También necesitas:
• Estar listo a las 9:30 en tu hotel
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.

¿Han pasado *más de 2 años* desde tu última inmersión?

msg: Hi there! We're a family from Canada staying in Cartagena next month. My wife and I are both Advanced Open Water divers, and we have two kids, aged 11 and 7. What could each of us do on a day trip from Cartagena, and how much would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

What a great family plan! A day out at the Rosario Islands works beautifully with mixed ages and levels — the reef is gorgeous and there's something for everyone. 🌊

Here's how a day trip from Cartagena could look for your family:

**The two of you (Advanced certified):** the *Fun Dives – 2 dives* day trip is ideal — two guided reef dives, boat from Cartagena and back the same day, lunch included. If you'd like to add a certification, the *Fish Identification* or *Naturalist* specialty also runs as a 1-day trip with 2 dives.

**Your 11-year-old:** can join the *Snorkeling Tour* (from age 6), or if they're keen to try diving, the *Dive Mini Course* (from age 10) — theory, pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor. Minors need to be accompanied by a responsible adult.

**Your 7-year-old:** snorkeling is the option — the *Snorkeling Tour* is open from age 6, so they can enjoy the reef from the surface. Diving programs start at 8 (Bubble Makers) and 10 (mini-course).

I'm leaving the per-person prices for each of these below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Would you like me to help you put the day together step by step?

msg: Good afternoon. I am from Germany and I hold an Open Water certification, although I have not dived for three years. I am staying in Getsemaní and I would like to dive next Wednesday. My flight home leaves on Thursday at 22:00. Is this possible, and what would you recommend?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon! Diving in the Rosario Islands is a beautiful plan, and your timing works out nicely. 🌊

Since it's been more than two years since your last dive, the right option is our **Refresher** (a review for certified divers, booked as the Dive Mini Course): a bit of theory, practice in the water and a dive with an instructor, so you get back in comfortably.

**About your flight:** after recreational diving you must wait at least **18 hours** before flying (the refresher counts as 18 hours too). The hours count from the last dive, not from the return to Cartagena. Diving on Wednesday, with daytime activities ending around 12:00–1:00 p.m., you can fly from 7:00 a.m. on Thursday — so your Thursday 22:00 flight is perfectly fine. ✅

One thing to keep in mind: the online system closes at 4:30 p.m. the day before, so for Wednesday you'd want to book before that.

Would you like me to help you set up the booking? Here's the link where you pick your date and pay: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: Thank you. What exactly does the refresher consist of? I would prefer to do proper dives on Wednesday: could I do a short review with the guide in the morning and then the 2 dives on the same day? I could also come on Tuesday if necessary.
reply:
The refresher is a full day on its own, so it can't be combined with the 2 dives on the same day. Here's what it consists of:

- Meeting at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m. (5 min from the historic center)
- Speedboat to the Rosario Islands (approx. 1 hour)
- Welcome at our island base and equipment setup, with instructor support throughout
- Pool session: theory and confined-water practice
- 1 reef dive + surface interval
- Lunch at the hotel facilities
- Return to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.)

It includes the National Park entrance fee, mandatory dive insurance, boat transport, pool training + 1 ocean dive with a PADI instructor, equipment, lunch and the eco-social contribution to DIVE TO HEAL. Not included: ground transport to the dock, photos/videos, tips, extra food, or return on a different date.

So the natural plan is: **refresher on Tuesday, then the 2 dives on Wednesday** — two different dive sites, each dive 40–50 minutes. And your Thursday 22:00 flight is fine either way, since you'd fly well over 18 hours after the last dive. 🌊

msg: Buenas tardes. Somos 6 amigos de Bogotá, todos certificados, y queremos hacer dos días de buceo saliendo desde Cartagena. ¿Tienen descuento de grupo? Dos de nosotros llevamos nuestro equipo completo: ¿hay descuento por eso y se suma al de grupo?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué bacano, 6 amigos certificados con dos días de buceo en las Islas del Rosario! 🌊

Te cuento cómo funcionan los descuentos:

**Descuento de grupo:** sí, 10% para grupos de 5 personas o más, y se suma al 10% de descuento online (20% total reservando online). Ojo: no se aplica automático, hay que pedírselo al equipo **antes de pagar** — si pagan sin pedirlo, ya no se puede aplicar después.

**Descuento por equipo propio:** 5% si traen el equipo COMPLETO (regulador, BCD/chaleco, traje, máscara, aletas). Aplica solo a quienes traen todo el equipo, en buceo recreativo.

**¿Se suman?** El de equipo propio se suma al online, pero **no se suma al de grupo**. Es decir, cada uno se acumula solo con el 10% online, no los tres juntos.

Para los dos días de buceo desde Cartagena tienen dos opciones:
- **Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas):** 316 USD / 1.154.000 COP online (351 USD / 1.282.000 COP normal). Hay que dormir en las islas, almuerzo solo el día 1.
- **Paquete de 5 inmersiones (2 días, incluye nocturna):** 392 USD / 1.429.000 COP online (436 USD / 1.587.000 COP normal). También hay que dormir en las islas, almuerzo solo el día 1.

No hay descuento ni tarifa especial por ser colombiano: el precio es el mismo, solo cambia la moneda (COP).

¿Quieres que te pase con un asesor del equipo para aplicar el descuento de grupo y cuadrar la reserva? 🤿

msg: Muy claro, gracias. Preferiríamos dormir en Cartagena: ¿podemos hacer dos salidas de un día, ida y vuelta cada día, en vez del paquete? ¿Cuánto saldría por persona con el descuento de grupo? Y para los dos que llevamos equipo, ¿qué nos conviene más?
reply:
¡Claro que sí! Pueden hacer dos salidas de un día, ida y vuelta cada día desde Cartagena, en vez del paquete. Es la opción perfecta si prefieren dormir en Cartagena: cada día salen a las 8:00 a.m. del Muelle de la Bodeguita y regresan a las 3:00 p.m. (llegada aprox. 4:15 p.m.), con lancha, 2 inmersiones guiadas, equipo y almuerzo incluidos. 🌊

El valor exacto por persona con ese 20% lo cierra un asesor al armar la reserva, porque yo no calculo precios finales.

Y para los dos que traen equipo completo: el 5% por equipo propio se suma al 10% online, pero **no se suma al de grupo**. Así que a ellos les conviene comparar: o el 20% de grupo, o el 15% de equipo propio + online. Como el de grupo es mayor, normalmente les sale mejor el de grupo — pero eso se lo confirma el asesor con los números en la mano.

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

🤿

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *630.000 COP* por persona · 6 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

⚠️ Si alguno lleva *más de 2 años* sin bucear, se añade el *refresher* (el minicurso: piscina y una inmersión con instructor): *655.000 COP* por persona. ¿Es el caso de alguno de ustedes?

El valor final por persona con el 20% lo cierra un asesor al armar la reserva, porque yo no calculo precios finales.

Y para los dos que llevan equipo completo: el 5% por equipo propio se suma al 10% online (15%), pero **no se suma al de grupo**. Como el de grupo es mayor (20%), les conviene quedarse con el de grupo. Ojo: el de equipo propio solo aplica con el equipo COMPLETO (regulador, BCD, traje, máscara, aletas).

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

🌊

🤿 *Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día)*
💰 *630.000 COP* por persona · 6 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

¿Quieren que les pase con un asesor para reservar y coordinar el pago? 🌊

msg: Hey! I'm an American diver, Advanced Open Water. I'm renting a house on Airbnb on Isla Grande next week, it's called Villa Marea. I'd like to do two dives. Can you pick me up there? How does that work?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Love that you're staying right on Isla Grande — you're already in the heart of the Rosario Islands, and two dives there is a great plan! 🐠

About pick-up at Villa Marea: since it's an Airbnb and not one of the hotels on our list, an advisor needs to confirm the pickup logistics before you book and pay. If the house has maritime access, the boat can often come directly; if not, we'd point you to the nearest dock or meeting point. So don't book until that's confirmed.

How the day works once you're on the islands:
- Hotel/house pick-up between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (if there's boat access)
- Transfer to our base and gear setup
- 2 open-water dives with a surface interval at the base
- Back at your place around 12:00–1:00 p.m.

The 2-dive Fun Dives from the islands is 124 USD / 440.000 COP per person online (138 USD / 489.000 COP regular), certification required, gear included, lunch not included.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to confirm the pickup at Villa Marea?

msg: Buenas tardes. Mi esposa y yo venimos de Medellín a Cartagena de luna de miel y nos gustaría probar el buceo. Nunca lo hemos hecho y nos da un poquito de nervios. ¿Cuánto cuesta y qué incluye? Nos estamos quedando en Bocagrande.
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

¡Qué bacano que quieran probar el buceo en su luna de miel! 🐠 Y tranqui con los nervios: para eso está el Minicurso de Buceo, pensado justo para quienes nunca han buceado. Van con instructor PADI todo el tiempo, empiezan en piscina y luego hacen su primera inmersión en el arrecife. Se van a sentir en buenas manos.

Te cuento qué incluye el Minicurso saliendo desde Cartagena:
- Entrenamiento en piscina + 1 inmersión en mar con instructor PADI
- Equipo de buceo completo
- Transporte en lancha Cartagena–Islas–Cartagena
- Almuerzo
- Tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural y seguro obligatorio de buceo
- Aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL

No incluye: transporte terrestre al muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas, comida adicional ni regreso en una fecha distinta.

El punto de encuentro es el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a.m. (a 5 min del centro histórico); desde Bocagrande llegas por tu cuenta, la lancha sale hacia las islas y el regreso a Cartagena es sobre las 3:00 p.m.

Te dejo los precios por persona a continuación.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Tour de Snorkeling: 448.000 COP · 497.000 COP

¿Quieres que te ayude a cuadrar la fecha para los dos?

msg: Gracias. Nos interesa el minicurso, para los dos. ¿A qué profundidad se baja? Y mi esposa pregunta si hace falta saber nadar muy bien, porque ella nada lo justo. Quisiéramos ir el sábado 14 de noviembre.
reply:
¡Con mucho gusto! El minicurso es un bautizo de un día: no certifica, pero es la mejor forma de probar el buceo sin experiencia previa. 🤿

Sobre la profundidad: en el minicurso se baja hasta 12 metros máximo, y lo habitual es entre 5 y 12 metros. Siempre con instructor PADI al lado y respetando tu ritmo.

Y lo de nadar: no hace falta nadar muy bien. La práctica se hace en aguas confinadas (piscina) y en la inmersión vas acompañada del instructor todo el tiempo, con el equipo puesto. Muchísima gente que nada "lo justo" lo disfruta sin problema. 🐠

Para el sábado 14 de noviembre, la reserva la cierra un asesor del equipo, que te coordina el pago y te envía el formulario médico que hay que completar antes.

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.

msg: Hola, buenos días. Soy Diana, de Bogotá. Quiero sacarme la certificación de buceo y he pensado hacerlo en Cartagena en enero. Tengo asma leve, controlada con inhalador, y hace años que no tengo una crisis. ¿Puedo hacer el curso igual? ¿Cuánto dura y cuánto cuesta?
reply:
¡Hola Diana, bienvenida! Qué chévere que quieras sacar tu certificación con nosotros en Cartagena. 🐠

Sobre el curso: el Curso Básico PADI (Open Water) dura 2 días. El día 1 empiezas con la teoría online (PADI eLearning, unas 10-12 horas que haces antes) y luego la práctica en las islas: piscina + 4 inmersiones de certificación con instructor. Sales desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a.m. y el día 2 regresas a Cartagena a las 3:00 p.m. (llegada aprox. 4:15 p.m.). msg: Hey! Planning a bachelor party in Cartagena in February, there will be 6 of us from Texas. Three of the guys are certified and three have never dived. We want one day out on the water together. What's the deal price-wise for a group like ours? And can we pay with US credit cards? One of us would pay for everybody.
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Love this plan — a bachelor party day out on the Rosario Islands reef is a great way to do it! 🎉 February is a beautiful time to be out there, and we dive every day of the year (except Dec 25 and Jan 1), so you've got plenty of dates to pick from.

Quick heads-up on the group, so nobody gets surprised: certified diving and the intro experience are two separate bookings, and they don't put everyone in the water on the same dive. The three certified guys can do the Fun Dives – 2 dives (one day, round trip from Cartagena, lunch included). The three who've never dived can't join those dives, but they have options: the Dive Mini Course (a 1-day intro experience — fun, but not a certification), the Snorkeling Tour, or coming along as a Companion on the boat. You can all be out on the water the same day, just on different activities.

On payment: yes — international guests pay 100% by card on our website, and with a foreign card the passport is used as the ID document. One person can pay for the whole group in a single booking. 💳

I'm leaving the per-person prices below. Since you're 6, you also qualify for the group discount — just ask the team to apply it before paying, because it isn't automatic.

Here are the booking links so you can pick the date and number of people:
- Certified diving (2 dives): https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en
- Dive Mini Course: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en
- Snorkeling Tour: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/superficio/3?language=en

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like me to help you put the group's booking together step by step?

msg: Gracias. Mientras me escriben, una consulta más: mi vuelo de regreso a Santiago sale el martes 10 a las 6:00 de la mañana. Si buceo el lunes 9, ¿llego bien con el tiempo de espera para volar?
reply:
Con buceo recreativo hay que esperar al menos 18 horas desde la última inmersión para volar. Si buceas el lunes 9 y las inmersiones de día terminan hacia las 12:00-13:00, podrías volar desde las 7:00 a.m. del día siguiente.

Tu vuelo sale el martes 10 a las 6:00 a.m., o sea una hora antes de ese margen, así que no llegarías con las 18 horas completas. La opción que sí encaja sería bucear el domingo 8, para tener el lunes completo de espera antes del vuelo.

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan exacto. 🌊

msg: Good afternoon. My name is Anna, I am from Germany. I will stay at the Hotel San Pedro de Majagua on Isla Grande from November 20 to 24. I am a PADI Advanced diver with about 80 dives, my last dive was in September in Egypt. How does it work when I am already on the island: do you pick me up at the hotel, and what does it cost? I would like to dive on two of the days.
reply:
Hi, Anna! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good afternoon, Anna! Lovely to hear from you — and great choice staying at San Pedro de Majagua, that's our dive base on Isla Grande, so everything is very easy from there. 🌊

Yes, pick-up is included at no extra charge: since you're staying at our base hotel, the boat picks you up right there, and the exact time is coordinated with you. For a two-day diving plan the rhythm is: hotel pick-up around 9:30–9:45 a.m., transfer to the dive center for fitting and equipment, two open-water dives with a surface interval at the base, and back at your hotel around 12:00–1:00 p.m. Same on the second day.

For two days of diving from the island you have a few options: the 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives), the 4-dive package with 3 daytime dives plus a night dive, or the 5-dive package over 2 days. With your Advanced certification and 80 dives you'll enjoy the reef sites around the Rosarios a lot.

I'm leaving the prices per person below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 3 daytime + 1 night dive): 236 USD · 262 USD
• 5-dive package (2 days): 319 USD · 354 USD

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like me to help you put the booking together for two of your days?

msg: Yes, the 4-dive package with daytime dives sounds right, on November 22 and 23. My flight home leaves Cartagena on November 24 at 16:00. Is this safe after diving? On the boat back to Cartagena: the return to Cartagena on a different date from the plan is not included, so that transfer isn't part of the package. If you'd like to come back with our boat on the 24th, a member of our team arranges it (space on the boat, etc.) — I can connect you with a team advisor for that if you'd like. Your large suitcase is no problem for the boat; just let the team know when the transfer is arranged.

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

**Going to the island the day before:** that wouldn't lower the course price — the Open Water course is a fixed price per person and includes the boat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena, so arriving early on your own doesn't take anything off. msg: Just me. Okay, I'll start from Cartagena then. What should I bring with me for the two days? I only have my big backpack, can I take it on the boat or leave it somewhere? I'd also love to bring my GoPro. And can I pay in cash when I arrive? My UK card charges me a fee abroad.
reply:
Hiya Priya! Great, starting from Cartagena it is. 🌊

**What to bring:** swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving gear is included in the course, so you don't need to carry any.

**Your big backpack:** each person can bring one backpack or bag on the boat. If it's a suitcase, that has to be arranged with a team member beforehand — and if you'd rather not take it, we can store it at our office in Cartagena. On the island there are also lockers at our base where you can leave your things (clothes, phone, wallet) while you dive.

**GoPro:** sure thing, bring it! Just note that underwater photos and videos aren't included in the course, so it's all yours to film. 🎥

**Paying in cash:** for international guests the payment is 100% by card on the website at the time of booking, using your passport as the ID document — cash at the dock isn't an option. I know your UK card charges a fee abroad, so it's worth checking with your bank whether that fee applies here before you book.

You'll also need:
• With this plan you must stay at least 1 night on the Rosario Islands (hotel not included)
• The theory is done through PADI eLearning (approx. 10 to 12 hours). You must complete it before starting the practical phase.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• Minimum age: 10 and over.

msg: ¿Me tocaría hacer algún repaso antes? ¿En qué consiste y cuánto cuesta en pesos?
reply:
Sí, con 4 años sin bucear te toca el refresher antes de la salida de buceo. Es un repaso tranquilo para volver al agua con confianza, y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida, así que lo ideal es hacerlo el primero y bucear los demás días. 🤿

*En qué consiste* (saliendo desde Cartagena):
• Encuentro en el Muelle de la Bodeguita a las 8:00 a.m.
• Lancha rápida a las Islas del Rosario (aprox. 1 hora)
• Bienvenida en la base y entrega de equipo, con instructor acompañándote todo el proceso
• Sesión en piscina: teoría y práctica en aguas confinadas
• 1 inmersión en arrecifes + intervalo de superficie
• Almuerzo en las instalaciones del hotel
• Regreso a Cartagena a las 3:00 p.m. (llegada estimada 4:15 p.m.)

Incluye lancha, equipo, almuerzo, seguro y entrada al Parque. No hay teoría que estudiar antes: todo se hace allí con el instructor. Eso sí, para el refresher se usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque ya seas buzo certificado.

También incluye:
• Tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural
• Aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL
• Recogida en hotel (si tiene acceso marítimo)
• Profesional PADI acompañando la actividad
• 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado

También necesitas:
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

¿Saldrías desde Cartagena? Y cuéntame qué días tienes, para ubicar el refresher el primero. 🐠

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo (en los de varios días, el del primer día)
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Minicurso de Buceo: 475.000 COP · 528.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 440.000 COP · 489.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 665.000 COP · 739.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 720.000 COP · 800.000 COP

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? Así te paso el plan exacto. 🌊

msg: Me alojo en el centro histórico. ¿A qué hora y dónde hay que estar, y qué incluye el precio?
reply:
La recogida no es en el hotel: saliendo desde Cartagena, cada persona llega por su cuenta al *Muelle de la Bodeguita*, a las *8:00 a.m.* (está a unos 5 minutos del centro histórico, así que te queda cerquita). La salida es puntual, mejor llegar 10-15 minutos antes. El regreso a Cartagena es a las 3:00 p.m., con llegada estimada 4:15 p.m. 🚤

*Qué incluye el precio* (saliendo desde Cartagena):
• Transporte en lancha rápida Cartagena–Islas–Cartagena
• Tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural
• Seguro obligatorio de buceo
• Equipo de buceo
• Almuerzo en las instalaciones del hotel
• Aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL
En el refresher, además: entrenamiento en piscina + 1 inmersión en el mar con instructor PADI. En la salida de buceo: 2 inmersiones guiadas con un profesional PADI certificado.

*No incluye*: transporte terrestre hasta el muelle, fotos o videos submarinos, propinas, comida adicional fuera del almuerzo, ni regreso en una fecha distinta a la programada.

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
• Minicurso de Buceo: 655.000 COP · 727.000 COP
• Salidas de Buceo - 2 inmersiones (1 día): 630.000 COP · 700.000 COP
• Paquete de 3 inmersiones (1 día, 2 diurnas + 1 nocturna): 1.017.000 COP · 1.130.000 COP
• Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas): 1.154.000 COP · 1.282.000 COP

¿Para cuántas personas sería: solo para ti o van más? 😊

msg: Hi! We're two certified divers visiting Cartagena next week from Chicago. Do you run dive trips to the Rosario Islands?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, we do! And you're going to love it — the Rosario Islands are a protected national park with warm Caribbean water, coral reefs and lots of marine life, just 45–60 minutes by boat from Cartagena. 🐠

For certified divers departing from Cartagena, the classic option is **Fun Dives – 2 dives (1 day)**:
- 2 guided reef dives with a PADI professional
- Boat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena, lunch, gear, park entrance fee and dive insurance included
- Departure from Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m., back in Cartagena around 4:15 p.m.

If you'd like more diving, there are also multi-day packages (5, 7 or 9 dives), which include a night dive and require staying overnight on the islands.

One thing to keep in mind: if it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required, and it takes its own day.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Our flight home leaves at 7:00 AM the day after we dive. Is that okay?
reply:
For certified divers, the minimum wait before flying is **18 hours after the last dive**, counted from the last dive itself (not from the return to Cartagena). With daytime dives ending around 12:00–1:00 p.m., you can fly from **7:00 a.m. the next day** — so a 7:00 a.m. flight the day after diving fits, as long as the last dive is a daytime one. ✈️

One thing to keep in mind: if your plan includes a **night dive**, the 18 hours count from that night dive, so a 7:00 a.m. flight the next morning would not work. In that case, the last dive would need to be the day before your flight day.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Buenas tardes, somos una familia de Ciudad de México con tres hijos de 7, 11 y 14 años. Mi esposo y yo no tenemos certificación. ¿Qué actividades podemos hacer todos en las islas?
reply:
¡Hola! 🪸 Soy *Coral*, de *Diving Planet* — buceamos todo el año en las Islas del Rosario, saliendo desde Cartagena o desde las propias islas. 🌊

Qué chévere que vengan en familia a las Islas del Rosario, se van a enamorar del Caribe. 🌊

Déjame contarte qué encaja con cada uno, porque las edades permiten varias cosas:

- **El de 7 años:** puede hacer **snorkeling** (desde los 6 años) y también ir en la lancha con ustedes.
- **El de 11 años:** puede hacer **Bubble Makers** (8 a 10 años)... ese ya no le aplica por edad, pero sí puede hacer el **Minicurso de Buceo** (desde los 10), igual que el de 14.
- **El de 14 años:** **Minicurso de Buceo** sin problema.
- **Tu esposo y tú, sin certificación:** el **Minicurso de Buceo** es ideal — es su primera experiencia bajo el agua con instructor, sin necesidad de certificación.

Y lo bacano: **pueden hacerlo todos el mismo día**. Se pueden combinar snorkel y minicurso en un mismo tour, así nadie se queda por fuera. 🐠

¿Me confirmas si ya estarían hospedados en las islas o si saldrían desde Cartagena? Con eso te armo bien el plan y te comparto el link para reservar. 😊

*Precios por persona* (online · normal):
*Desde Cartagena* — lancha desde el Muelle de la Bodeguita · con almuerzo
• Minicurso de Buceo: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Tour de Snorkeling: 126 USD · 140 USD
*Ya en las Islas del Rosario* — recogida en tu hotel si tiene acceso por lancha · sin almuerzo
• Minicurso de Buceo: 134 USD · 149 USD
• Tour de Snorkeling: 45 USD · 50 USD

*Descuento de grupo (5 personas o más):* 10% más, que se suma al 10% online (20% en total reservando online). No es automático: hay que pedirlo al equipo antes de pagar, o se pierde. No aplica a cursos PADI.

Entonces, ¿ya estarás en las *Islas del Rosario* (salida desde las islas)? 🌴

msg: Do you pick us up at the hotel? What time, and do we need to bring our own gear?
reply:
Yes — since you're staying at Cocoliso, which is our island base, pick-up there is confirmed and included at no extra charge. 🌊

*Time:* hotel pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m. (8:00 a.m. for specialties). Daytime activities end around 12:00–1:00 p.m., and you're back at the hotel for lunch. Pick-up times are fixed, but if you need an adjustment a team advisor can review it.

*Gear:* no need to bring your own — diving and snorkeling gear is included in the dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and the PADI courses. Just bring swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. (If you do bring your complete gear, there's a 5% discount on recreational diving and courses.)

You'll also need:
• For recreational dive outings, the refresher and the courses for already-certified divers (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster and specialties), you must present your certified diver card. You can send us a photo of it beforehand or show it on the day of the activity.
• To process the insurance, you must complete the form we send in the booking confirmation email.
• The medical form is required for courses or mini-courses: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol (the form is in Spanish). The link can be sent together with the booking link; if you have not completed it, it is sent again in the booking confirmation email. Exception: the refresher (a review with an instructor) uses the course medical form, even if you are a certified diver.
• If it's been more than 2 years since your last dive, a refresher is normally required; very experienced divers (500+ dives, Dive Master) are reviewed by a member of our team. If you already did a refresher or a PADI ReActivate at another centre, it counts as your refresher and you can dive directly. The refresher is the mini course (pool and one dive with an instructor) and takes its own day: the dive trip cannot be done that same day. Anyone staying several days does the refresher on the first day and dives on the others.

Shall we go for the *2-dive trip* for you and, for your companion, the *mini-course*, *snorkeling* or just coming along on the *boat*? 🌊

reply:

msg: Queremos hacer las 2 inmersiones en un día. ¿Cómo reservamos todos juntos y cuándo hay que pedir el descuento?
reply:
¡Bacano, las 2 inmersiones en un día es un plan perfecto! 🤿 Se bucea en dos puntos distintos del arrecife, cada inmersión de 40 a 50 minutos, y el precio no cambia por eso.

Para reservar todos juntos: se hace por la página web, en el enlace de la salida de 2 inmersiones, eligiendo la fecha y poniendo *6 personas* en el calendario. Ahí mismo queda el grupo completo en una sola reserva:

https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=es

Ojo con el horario: el sistema cierra a las 4:30 PM del día anterior. Si ya pasó esa hora, se reserva igual por la web para el siguiente día disponible.

Y sobre el descuento de grupo: hay que *pedirlo al equipo ANTES de pagar*. Si pagan sin pedirlo, después no se puede devolver. Así que lo ideal es pedirlo primero y luego hacer el pago en el enlace. 😉

Si sales desde las islas, antes necesito saber tu hotel.

Quien no es colombiano ni residente en Colombia paga en dólares (USD) con tarjeta en la web; la tarifa es la misma, solo cambia la moneda.

¿Saldrías *desde Cartagena* o ya estás *en las Islas del Rosario*? 🌊

msg: Hi, I'm a German traveler in Cartagena and I've never dived. I'd like to get my Open Water certification. How long does the course take?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Great choice! The Open Water course is the perfect way to start — you'll love the Rosario Islands as your first diving playground. 🌊

The course takes **2 days**:

- **Phase 1:** online theory (PADI eLearning), which you do before arriving.
- **Day 1:** meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m., speedboat to the islands, welcome and equipment check, pool session, then 2 certification dives + lunch (included). You then head to your hotel on the islands for the night.
- **Day 2:** second pool session + 2 final dives, then return to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.), and your PADI Open Water Diver certification is processed.

One important detail: since it's a 2-day course, you need to stay on the islands at least one night (the night of day 1) — there's no commuting back to Cartagena. Accommodation isn't included and is booked directly with the hotel.

The price is **693 USD online** (770 USD regular), and it certifies you to dive down to 18 m.

Would you like me to help you set up the booking?

msg: Actually, I only have two free days and I'm not sure I want a full course. What about just trying diving once without certification?
reply:
That's a great option! 🐠 The **Dive Mini Course** is exactly that: a one-day try-dive, an introduction to diving. No prior experience or certification needed, and nothing to do online beforehand — the theory is done there on the day, along with pool practice and one ocean dive with an instructor. It doesn't certify, but it's a lovely first taste of the reef.

It fits perfectly in a single day from Cartagena: boat out to the islands, activity ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m., lunch included, and the boat back to Cartagena at 3:00 p.m. (arriving around 4:15 p.m.).

One thing to keep in mind if you're flying soon after: after the mini course you should wait at least 12 hours before a flight, counting from the dive, which ends around noon — so from midnight that same day you're fine to fly.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

How many people would this be for: just you, or more? 😊

msg: ¿Ella puede hacer algo en el agua? ¿Y necesitaría algún permiso médico?
reply:
Sí, ella puede hacer snorkel en superficie — es lo único en el agua que se puede durante el embarazo. Bucear con botella no: ni minicurso, ni salidas, ni cursos (DAN y los ginecólogos lo desaconsejan durante todo el embarazo).

Sobre el permiso médico: para el snorkel no se pide formulario médico, pero sí necesita el visto bueno de su médico antes de la actividad. Eso se lo tiene que dar su ginecólogo, no nosotros. 🤿

Y tú, como estás certificado, buceas con normalidad — solo recuerda llevar tu carné de buzo (o una foto) y completar el formato del seguro que llega en el correo de confirmación.

También necesitas:
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Para cursos o minicursos se requiere el formulario médico: https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. El enlace se puede enviar junto con el de la reserva; si no lo has completado, te llega otra vez en el correo de confirmación de la reserva. Excepción: el refresher (repaso con instructor) usa el formulario médico de curso, aunque seas buzo certificado.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.
• Si llevas más de 2 años sin bucear, normalmente se requiere un refresh; los buzos muy experimentados (500+ inmersiones, Dive Master) los revisa un asesor del equipo. Si ya hiciste un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, cuenta como tu refresh y puedes bucear directamente. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Quien viene varios días hace el refresher el primero y bucea los demás.

¿Te animas con la *salida de 2 inmersiones*, un *paquete de varios días* o un *curso avanzado*? 🌊

msg: Tell me about the 3-dive package with a night dive. Where would I sleep and is the hotel included?
reply:
The 3-dive package is a great one — two daytime dives plus a night dive, and night diving in the Rosario Islands is a really special experience. 🌙🤿

The hotel is *not included* — you book your accommodation on the Rosario Islands directly with the hotel. What the package does include is the National Park fee, dive insurance, speedboat Cartagena–Islands–Cartagena, 3 guided dives with a PADI professional, full gear, lunch on day 1, and the Dive To Heal contribution.

How the day goes: you meet at Muelle de la Bodeguita at 8:00 a.m., take the boat over (about 1 hour), set up gear, do 2 dives with a surface interval and lunch, then the night dive in the evening. You stay that night at your chosen island hotel, and the next day you return to Cartagena on our boat, which leaves the base at 3:00 p.m. and arrives around 4:15 p.m.

For where to sleep: our base is at Hotel San Pedro de Majagua and Hotel Cocoliso on Isla Grande — staying at either one makes pick-up direct. Other hotels in the area with maritime access are Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras and Pao Pao.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included (on multi-day plans, the first day's)

msg: Un detalle: mi esposo buceó por última vez en abril de 2022 y yo en enero de este año, en Capurganá. ¿Eso cambia algo para él?
reply:
Sí, para él cambia: como su última inmersión fue en abril de 2022, ya pasaron más de 2 años, y en ese caso normalmente se requiere un refresh para volver al agua con seguridad. El refresher es el minicurso (piscina y una inmersión con instructor) y ocupa su propio día: ese mismo día no se hace la salida de buceo. Como vienen varios días, él podría hacer el refresher el primero y bucear los demás. Tú, con tu última inmersión en enero de este año, estás al día y puedes bucear directamente. 🐠

Si él ya hizo un refresh o un PADI ReActivate en otro centro, eso cuenta como su refresh y puede bucear directamente. Y si es un buzo muy experimentado (500+ inmersiones o Dive Master), un asesor del equipo lo revisa para determinar si el refresh es necesario.

También necesitas:
• Ser buzo certificado y presentar tu carnet
• Con este plan debes alojarte 1 noche en las Islas del Rosario (hotel no incluido)
• Para procesar el seguro, debes completar el formato que te enviamos en el correo de confirmación.
• Después de bucear, esperar mínimo 18 horas antes de tomar un vuelo
• Edad mínima: desde los 10 años.
• Para las salidas de buceo recreativo, el refresher y los cursos para buzos ya certificados (Advanced, Rescue, Divemaster y especialidades), debes presentar tu carne de buzo certificado. Puedes enviarnos una foto del carné antes o mostrarlo el día de la actividad.
• Qué llevar: bañador, toalla, crema de sol, gafas de sol y ropa cómoda. El equipo de buceo o de snorkel va incluido en las salidas de buceo, el minicurso, el snorkel y los cursos PADI; en el Divemaster se usa equipo propio.

🤿 *Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas)*
💰 *1.154.000 COP* por persona · 2 personas

El pago es en pesos colombianos (COP): pueden pagar *100 % online* o un *anticipo del 50 %* con el enlace, el QR o Llave que envía el asesor, y el *otro 50 % el día de la actividad*.

¿Quieren que les pase con un asesor para reservar y coordinar el pago? 🌊

msg: ¿Qué incluye cada salida? Queremos saber si hay que llevar almuerzo y si el transporte hasta el muelle corre por nuestra cuenta.
reply:
¡Con mucho gusto te cuento! 🤿

El *Paquete de 4 inmersiones (2 días, 4 diurnas)* incluye:
• Tarifa de ingreso al Parque Nacional Natural
• Seguro de buceo obligatorio
• Transporte en lancha rápida Cartagena–Islas–Cartagena
• Equipo de buceo
• Almuerzo el primer día
• Aporte eco-social a DIVE TO HEAL

Sobre el *almuerzo*: va incluido solo el primer día (arroz con pollo o arroz con vegetales, más agua todo el día y dulces de coco entre inmersiones). El segundo día no está incluido, así que ese día sí conviene llevar algo o comer por tu cuenta en la isla. Si alguno tiene alergia alimentaria, avísanos antes.

Y el *transporte hasta el muelle* corre por su cuenta: el punto de encuentro es el *Muelle de la Bodeguita*, a 5 minutos del centro histórico, a las *8:00 a.m.*, y no hay recogida en el hotel. El regreso a Cartagena es hacia las *4:15 p.m.*

Ojo con un detalle: como el paquete es de 2 días, hay que dormir en las islas la noche intermedia (el alojamiento no está incluido, se reserva directo con el hotel).
